> `src/custom-elements.json`; do not use this file as capability evidence.

## How to read this file

- A property/event/slot is listed only when it appears in the source manifest.
- “Supports `readonly`” is an exact lookup over the declaration's properties;
  it is not inferred from a sibling component.
- A missing property means “not listed in the inspected manifest,” not proof
  that a browser-native attribute or undocumented implementation is impossible.
- Agents must cite the generated section and source manifest path in issue
  comments.

## Drift and freshness

The target repository's CI should fail if:

- the source manifest cannot be parsed;
- a declaration/tag is omitted from the generated index;
- the committed output differs from a fresh render;
- the source commit marker is missing.

The Figma plugin and chat bots should show the generated-at timestamp and
source commit. A stale cache must be labeled stale and should not answer a
capability question with “supported.”
